title: Técnico de Manutenção Mecânica Sênior
description:
About Us

We are Yokohama TWS, a leading global supplier of tires and complete wheels for the agricultural, material handling, construction, motorcycles segments.

We design and manufacture tire and wheel solutions made for the future. With a combination of value, safety and ease, our solutions provide a more productive and sustainable performance our customers demand.

We pair the expertise and power of our global reach with the care and knowledge of local proximity. This brings innovation, technology and sustainability together to answer the specific needs of our customers. All while continuing to reduce our and their impact on the planet.

Our people take ownership to deliver on this promise every day.

We are a global Company with a local reach, operating in more than 50 Countries worldwide with 6,700 employees of 40 different nationalities, 14 state-of-the-art plants and 4 innovation centers. We are part of Yokohama Rubber Co., Ltd., a global leader in the tire industry with 860.5 billion yen in revenues (approx. 6 billion euro), over 28,000 people around the globe and with operations in more than 120 countries.

If you have an entrepreneurial mindset, enjoy taking responsibilities and getting things done in the right way, join us! We are plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in a truly dynamic and easy-going environment.

Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Mecânico(a) Sênior para atuar na manutenção mecânica industrial da Yokohama TWS, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos equipamentos da planta.

Essa função é essencial para manter a estabilidade operacional, solucionar falhas complexas, orientar mecânicos e técnicos mais jovens e suportar projetos de melhoria contínua, novos equipamentos e shutdowns.

Você fará parte de um time técnico altamente qualificado, com atuação direta nas rotinas de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, contribuindo para a redução de falhas e aumento da eficiência produtiva.

Principais Atividades

  • Executar manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva em máquinas, sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e pneumáticos.
  • Realizar diagnósticos complexos de falhas, propondo e executando soluções técnicas duradouras.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance dos equipamentos (MTTR, MTBF), propondo ações de melhoria.
  • Realizar análises de vibração, alinhamento, balanceamento e inspeções mecânicas avançadas.
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos técnicos, diagramas, catálogos e manuais de fabricantes.
  • Montar, ajustar e instalar equipamentos e componentes mecânicos críticos da linha produtiva.
  • Realizar inspeções rotineiras, identificando desgastes, riscos e pontos de intervenção.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de manutenção e execução de shutdowns e paradas programadas.
  • Registrar intervenções no sistema de manutenção, garantindo rastreabilidade e dados corretos.
  • Apoiar Engenharia e Supervisão na instalação de máquinas, melhorias de layout e projetos de CAPEX.
  • Zelar pela segurança durante as intervenções, seguindo normas de bloqueio, etiquetagem (LOTO) e procedimentos do SGI.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time.

Principais Requisitos

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção industrial (preferencialmente de borracha ou pneumática).
  • Domínio em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e pneumáticos.
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico de falhas complexas.
  • Conhecimento em interpretação de desenhos e especificações técnicas.
  • Vivência com TPM, Melhoria Contínua e ferramentas de manutenção.
  • Postura de liderança técnica e orientação de equipe.
  • Organização, disciplina e forte senso de segurança.

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) - Build A Global Mental Health Platfor
description:
To our friends in Brazil

We are specifically recruiting here because the React / Next.js talent is world‑class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge : Keep your day job, contribute 5‑10 hours / week, and earn substantial equity in a US‑based C‑Corp. This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.

Unacceptable. We're fixing it.

Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider‑centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.

Next: an AI‑powered booking and translation layer with real‑time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system‑level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.

The Opportunity : Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment : 5‑10 hours / week, equity‑only, alongside your primary role.

You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.

We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.

Who You Are (and how you show up)

Mission‑obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.

Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.

Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.

Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.

Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low‑ego reviews.

Efficiency and Output Driven : Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.

What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End‑to‑end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next :

  • Add recurring calendar availability
  • Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site

Roll out the Hotline

Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)

  • Add location‑based navigation
  • Add site‑wide translation and real‑time audio translation

API / MCP integrations

Our stack: Next.js / React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI‑assisted workflows (Cursor / Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.

The Deal : Transparent Equity Partnership

Merit‑based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.

Points‑for‑outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.

All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential "glue work" like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.

Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.

Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6‑month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3‑year period.

Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.

High‑impact bounties. Mission‑critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.

Locked‑in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.

No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.

Why This Will Define Your Career

Build Your US Track Record : This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.

USD‑Denominated Upside : You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar‑based asset ($100M+ target valuation).

Direct Access : You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.

Human Impact : Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.

Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.

This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.

To Apply : Send :

GitHub (or 1‑2 PRs you're proud of). If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.

A short note : why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through.

If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

description:
Job description

Estamos convidando pessoas com sólida experiência em pesquisa, estratégia ou desenvolvimento de intervenções digitais e gestão de projetos para dedicação em tempo integral, focada no desenvolvimento de avaliação sobre o impacto da Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS) na prontidão dos serviços, acesso, qualidade e eficiência. A contratação poderá servir para fins de pós-doutoramento, caso a pessoa selecionada seja tenha o grau de Doutorado

O(a) candidato(a) estará sediado(a) e irá compor uma equipe de pesquisa sobre serviços de saúde com sede no Centro de Integração de Dados e Conhecimentos para Saúde (CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA), Salvador, Bahia, Brasil.

O projeto é financiado pela Gates Foundation.

Encorajamos fortemente candidaturas de pesquisadores negro(a)s, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos menos representados.

Sobre a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS):

Em 2021, foi criada a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS), cujo propósito é integrar e unificar os dados de pacientes provenientes da rede estadual de saúde em um único repositório centralizado.

A REDS tem como foco a consolidação de prontuários eletrônicos, possibilitando, entre outros benefícios, a mensuração do cuidado e dos custos em nível individual do paciente, por meio de uma plataforma segura e atualizada em tempo real.

Considerando a ampla adoção do prontuário eletrônico na atenção primária, a REDS está em processo de expansão, impulsionada pela implementação do mesmo sistema de prontuário eletrônico utilizado em hospitais estaduais (o AGHUse).

Essa padronização é considerada estratégica e essencial para permitir a integração de dados com fins de coordenação do cuidado entre os diferentes níveis da rede de atenção à saúde.

A principal funcionalidade da REDS é viabilizar o acesso ao prontuário do paciente entre diferentes pontos da rede, consolidando dados de imunização, exames laboratoriais e registros clínicos, além de subsidiar análises de gestão orientadas à vigilância em saúde, ao monitoramento de políticas públicas e à tomada de decisão.

Main responsibilities

  • Articular a temática de redes interoperáveis, avaliação de impacto em serviços de saúde e análise de implementação de políticas e intervenções digitais na saúde entre os distintos grupos do projeto REDS
  • Auxiliar na gestão de equipe de pesquisadores de avaliação de impacto e epidemiologia
  • Produzir e aplicar um modelo metodológico de documentação e avaliação da REDS e sua integração com sistemas existentes, baseado em revisão de marcos conceituais sobre redes de interoperabilidade de dados em saúde e na sua proposta de valor para acesso e qualidade de serviços de saúde
  • Gerir a coleta, organização e análise dos dados de pesquisa qualitativa junto a participantes e demais pesquisadores
  • Documentar, sistematizar e apresentar aprendizados, ferramentas e recomendações para institucionalização dos achados do projeto.
  • Conduzir o planejamento e gerenciar o fluxo de entregas da pesquisa junto ao financiador internacional
  • Conduzir e apresentar resultados em reuniões de acompanhamento do projeto de pesquisa
  • Conduzir reuniões de engajamento de parceiros externos da pesquisa
  • Produzir, escrever e revisar artigos científicos e relatórios do projeto
  • Participar de eventos científicos, realizar apresentações e conduzir formações e oficinas

Requirements and skills

  1. Doutorado concluído ou em andamento* em Saúde Coletiva ou Saúde Pública, Epidemiologia, Ciências da Saúde, Gestão Pública, Economia, Ciências Sociais, Informática em Saúde, Ciências da Computação, ou áreas correlatas

description:
Estamos convidando pessoas com sólida experiência em pesquisa, estratégia ou desenvolvimento de intervenções digitais e gestão de projetos para dedicação em tempo integral, focada no desenvolvimento de avaliação sobre o impacto da Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS) na prontidão dos serviços, acesso, qualidade e eficiência. A contratação poderá servir para fins de pós-doutoramento, caso a pessoa selecionada seja tenha o grau de Doutorado.

O(a) candidato(a) estará sediado(a) e irá compor uma equipe de pesquisa sobre serviços de saúde com sede no Centro de Integração de Dados e Conhecimentos para Saúde (CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA), Salvador, Bahia, Brasil.

O projeto é financiado pela Gates Foundation.

Encorajamos fortemente candidaturas de pesquisadores negro(a)s, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos menos representados.

Sobre a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS)

Em 2021, foi criada a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS), cujo propósito é integrar e unificar os dados de pacientes provenientes da rede estadual de saúde em um único repositório centralizado.

A REDS tem como foco a consolidação de prontuários eletrônicos, possibilitando, entre outros benefícios, a mensuração do cuidado e dos custos em nível individual do paciente, por meio de uma plataforma segura e atualizada em tempo real.

Considerando a ampla adoção do prontuário eletrônico na atenção primária, a REDS está em processo de expansão, impulsionada pela implementação do mesmo sistema de prontuário eletrônico utilizado em hospitais estaduais (o AGHUse).

Essa padronização é considerada estratégica e essencial para permitir a integração de dados com fins de coordenação do cuidado entre os diferentes níveis da rede de atenção à saúde.

A principal funcionalidade da REDS é viabilizar o acesso ao prontuário do paciente entre diferentes pontos da rede, consolidando dados de imunização, exames laboratoriais e registros clínicos, além de subsidiar análises de gestão orientadas à vigilância em saúde, ao monitoramento de políticas públicas e à tomada de decisão.

  • Produzir e aplicar um modelo metodológico de documentação e avaliação da REDS e sua integração com sistemas existentes, baseado em revisão de marcos conceituais sobre redes de interoperabilidade de dados em saúde e na sua proposta de valor para acesso e qualidade de serviços de saúde

We are specifically recruiting here because the React / Next.js talent is world‑class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge : Keep your day job, contribute 5‑10 hours / week, and earn substantial equity in a US‑based C‑Corp. This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.

Unacceptable. We're fixing it.

Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider‑centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.

Next: an AI‑powered booking and translation layer with real‑time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system‑level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.

The Opportunity : Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment : 5‑10 hours / week, equity‑only, alongside your primary role.

You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.

We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.

Mission‑obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.

Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.

Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.

Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.

End‑to‑end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next :

API / MCP integrations

The Deal : Transparent Equity Partnership

Merit‑based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.

Points‑for‑outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.

All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential "glue work" like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.

Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.

Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6‑month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3‑year period.

Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.

High‑impact bounties. Mission‑critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.

Locked‑in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.

No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.

Why This Will Define Your Career

USD‑Denominated Upside : You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar‑based asset ($100M+ target valuation).

Direct Access : You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.

Human Impact : Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.

Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.

This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.

title: Senior UX / UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Ollyis a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.

We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.

A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.

The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX / UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.

Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.

You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture : Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion : Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design : Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking : Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error‑proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement : Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.

What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of professional UX / UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile / app design).

A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate

  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.

Expert-level proficiency in Figma

  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg / Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work / life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule.
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

Why Join Us?

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.

How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.

Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web / theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at https : / / caisoft.com

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.

Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.

Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.

Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.

Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.

Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.

Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.

Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.

Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.

Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.

Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.

Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.

Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.

Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.

Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.

Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.

Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.

Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.

Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.

Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.

Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.

Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.

Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.

Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.

Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.

Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.

Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.

ERP / MIS background preferred.

Print industry knowledge is mandatory.

Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.

Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.

Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.

Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.

Willing to work in shifts as required.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Strong documentation and organizational abilities.

Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).

Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.

Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.

Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.

Education

Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.

Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Europe)

Our network doesn’t just move fast, it hops. We handle millions of requests every second across 120+ PoPs on six continents, powering not just a lightning-fast CDN, but also a global Edge Computing platform, Streaming services, and petabyte-scale Storage.

As our footprint expands, so does the challenge, and the fun. That’s where you come in.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll design and shape the global infrastructure that makes bunny.net hop. You’ll work with bare metal and virtual servers, core internal applications like databases and internal tools, and the supporting infrastructure that ties it all together. You’ll have the autonomy to set the scope and delivery of your projects, but you’ll also thrive in collaboration, sharing knowledge, providing feedback, and teaming up to tackle complex challenges.

Your work will reduce busywork, speed up global deployments, and strengthen how bunny.net runs at every level.

What will you do?

  • Run and expand our hybrid infrastructure across 120+ PoPs, keeping it fast, reliable, and resilient
  • Solve complex challenges in large-scale distributed systems and networking stacks
  • Automate the boring stuff, reducing toil and streamlining server setup worldwide
  • Level up our monitoring game with meaningful metrics, alerts, and dashboards that keep us ahead of issues
  • Collaborate across teams to support new products, features, and big ideas with infrastructure expertise
  • Own the systems you build, participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation to keep everything performing at its best
  • Create tools and pipelines that make the team more efficient and the platform more powerful

Main requirements

What will you bring?

  • Proven experience running large-scale, multi-regional Linux-based hybrid infrastructures
  • Strong understanding of core internet building blocks like DNS, HTTP, and TLS (you’ve tinkered with things like nginx, TLS ciphers, and HTTP / 2 before)
  • Bare-metal expertise, from setup and operation to securing and debugging servers, even if they’re halfway across the globe
  • A growth mindset with eagerness to learn, adapt, and shape the future of a fast-moving technical stack, especially with a focus on reliability
  • A love for automation and Infrastructure-as-Code to eliminate repetitive work
  • Hands‑on experience with monitoring systems like metrics, alerts, logs, and runbooks (we run our own Prometheus exporters, craft our own Grafana dashboards, and write the alerts we respond to)
  • Solid networking skills, VLANs, routing, TCP / IP, DHCP, IPv6 all feel familiar to you
  • Experience running SQL / NoSQL databases like MariaDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, or Cassandra
  • Ability to write tools and scripts in Bash, Python, or Go

Where should you be located?

Fully remote across Europe — work from where you hop best.

Nice to have

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience with CDNs, edge computing, streaming platforms, or object storage projects
  • A passion for observability, with a good understanding of how systems behave as a whole, not just checking if they’re “healthy”
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks and using them to introduce meaningful, lasting improvements
  • Hands‑on involvement in network design, implementation, and monitoring (BGP, Spine‑Leaf, Anycast are all in your vocabulary)
  • Deep experience tuning and scaling databases such as MariaDB or Cassandra in high‑traffic environments.
  • Experience in Disaster Recovery or Business Continuity Planning (and ready to help shape bunny.net’s DR strategy)
  • Skills in hardware performance tuning, from NIC queues to flamegraphs and performance dashboards

Benefits & Perks

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

Remote‑first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

Performance‑based bonuses - Great work pays off, and we reward impact annually.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

Meeting‑free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non‑birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

Annual fluffle‑building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high‑fives turn into real ones.

Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via BetterHelp.com.

Wellness budget - An annual well‑being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work‑related or not.

Music on us - Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

  • Arrumação da loja: É preciso garantir a arrumação das prateleiras, pilhas e pontos extras da loja, bem como garantir também a devolução dos produtos desistidos pelos clientes;

  • Garrafas térmicas: Explicar aos clientes como devem ser testadas as garrafas térmicas, apenas com água quente e no período de 4 horas, não deve ser colocado café. Importante carimbar a nota.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Por aqui, temos o #VivoBemEstar, que estimula o nosso time a ter hábitos saudáveis e mais qualidade de vida! Disponibilizados aos nossos colaboradores consultas com nutricionista, psicólogos, serviço social, telemedicina, e muito mais!

Sobre nós

Somos uma empresa do Grupo Telefônica, líder em telecomunicações no Brasil. Trabalhamos com o propósito de Digitalizar para Aproximar pessoas, negócios e toda sociedade, construindo uma nação mais conectada e transformando a vida dos brasileiros. Buscamos ampliar a autonomia, a personalização e as escolhas em tempo real dos nossos clientes, colocando-os no comando da sua vida digital, com segurança e confiabilidade – tudo isso com a qualidade que só a Vivo tem.

Para que isso seja possível, lideramos um processo de transformação digital e estamos revolucionando nossa companhia de dentro para fora. Implementamos metodologias ágeis por toda a empresa, buscando nos conectar com as formas mais inovadoras e colaborativas de trabalho. Atuamos para fomentar um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, que estimula a criatividade, gerando inovação e aumentando o engajamento.

Acreditamos que a diversidade de pessoas, vivência, culturas, comportamentos, habilidades e atitudes é um diferencial, que reflete a sociedade em que vivemos. Temos um sólido programa interno, pautados nos pilares de Gênero, LGBTI+, Raça, PcD e 50+ para assegurar uma cultura mais inclusiva e um ambiente mais diverso e representativo. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, inspirada na diversidade e na inovação, que oferece espaço para todos, apoia e acolhe as diferenças.

Com a nossa Paixão Púrpura e seus norteadores- Conexão Humana, Curiosidade Viva, Atitude Transformadora e Ação Responsável - impulsionamos a capacidade humana de ser, sonhar e alcançar o futuro que queremos, por meio da tecnologia e todas as suas possiblidades.

Atualmente, conectamos cerca de 357,5 milhões de acessos à internet e telefonia móvel e fixa, além de TV por assinatura . Referência na telefonia móvel 4G e na banda larga fixa de ultra velocidade, oferecemos a TV por assinatura com mais canais HD do mercado e inúmeros aplicativos online.

description:
Company Description

MonetizeMail.co - We help scale DTC ecommerce brands using email marketing. We're passionate about helping brands make a real impact through email marketing. Whether you're looking to drive sales, build brand awareness, or increase customer engagement, we've got the expertise and creative energy to make it happen.

Role Description

We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) for a full‑time remote position, with a specific focus on cold calling. As an SDR, you will play a crucial role in our inside sales activities and lead generation efforts. Your primary responsibility will be to identify and qualify potential clients through cold calling, initiate contact, and nurture relationships to drive sales. This role requires effective communication with clients and close collaboration with the sales and business development teams to achieve sales targets.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct cold calling to identify and qualify potential clients
  • Initiate contact and build relationships with prospective clients
  • Effectively communicate the value proposition of our products / services
  • Nurture leads through follow‑ups and relationship‑building activities
  • Collaborate with the sales and business development teams to achieve sales targets
  • Maintain accurate records of lead interactions and sales activities in the CRM system

Compensation

Our compensation structure is designed to reward both consistent effort and exceptional performance. As a Sales Development Representative, you will receive:

  • Base Salary: $300 per month
  • Commission: 15% of Revenue Generated
  • Performance Fee: $10-25 per qualified sales call generated
  • Expected Salary: $2000 per month

This structure ensures that you have a stable base income while also providing the opportunity to significantly increase your earnings based on your success in generating qualified leads.

Additional Information

This job opportunity includes detailed standard operating procedures (SOPs) that cover any questions or details needed to successfully book qualified calls at scale. These SOPs provide comprehensive guidance to ensure your success. There is significant room for growth as an SDR / Cold Caller at MonetizeMail, where you could advance to become a Sales Development Manager and lead teams based on your experience and performance.

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Sua rotina como técnico de enfermagem será:

  • Auxiliar no preparo da sala cirúrgica/obstétrico, segundo cada caso específico, no provimento dos materiais necessários à realização de cada ato cirúrgico, conforme programação informada;
  • Receber o paciente, conferir pulseira de identificação conforme protocolo de cirurgia e parto seguro e certificar-se de que está devidamente preparado, encaminhá-lo para a sala e auxiliar no transporte da maca para a mesa cirúrgica/obstétrica e vice-versa;
  • Auxiliar na realização dos procedimentos pré-cirúrgico /obstétrico e anestésicos, posicionando o paciente e fornecendo os materiais necessários no decorrer de sua realização;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente durante a sua permanência no Centro, tendo em vista o seu bem-estar físico e psíquico, e auxiliar no seu encaminhamento ao setor de destino, após liberação do médico;
  • Executar as solicitações médicas e da Enfermeira, segundo orientações específicas e definidas;
  • Realizar controle de materiais esterilizados disponíveis para a realização de procedimentos, verificando sempre a data de validade, conforme rotina específica do setor;
  • Conferir o instrumental utilizado após cada ato cirúrgico/obstétrico e acondicioná-lo para fins de remessa para lavagem e esterilização;
  • Preencher as notas de sala segundo procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista a correta apropriação dos materiais utilizados e a confiabilidade na emissão da conta hospitalar correspondente;
  • Registrar os procedimentos realizados no prontuário, conforme procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista disponibilizar as informações necessárias para a continuidade do trabalho.
  • Manusear sistema PEP com prontuário eletrônico.
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem concluído;

Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

Ser a pessoa responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações acessíveis e confiáveis, conectando a área técnica às necessidades de negócio e garantindo que as soluções construídas sustentem a tomada de decisão estratégica da empresa.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Atuar na definição e implementação de arquiteturas de dados, tanto em Cloud quanto On-Premises;
  • Construir e manter estruturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Liderar tecnicamente times ou iniciativas de engenharia de dados;
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança e segurança da informação;
  • Possuir certificações Microsoft relevantes para a área (como Azure Data Engineer ou Azure Solutions Architect).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser;
  • Benefícios de alimentação e home office;

O que nos diferencia? Carreira e desenvolvimento: Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills, oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo.

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

Inscrição Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui. Bate-papo com People Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura. Atuar como Business Partner das áreas e Comercial local, fornecendo análises e informações financeiras.

Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência operacional e financeira, propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis.

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a diluição e envase de produtos saneantes conforme instruções técnicas e tabelas padrão;
  • Higienizar e preparar bombonas, almotolias e frascos pra uso;
  • Identificar e rotular corretamente todos os produtos diluídos, com informações completas e legíveis;
  • Preencher e assinar, junto ao farmacêutico, a ficha técnica de manipulação;
  • Realizar armazenamento dos produtos recebidos e diluídos conforme as normas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as medições da temperatura do ambiente de armazenamento e sala de manipulação;
  • Identificar e remover produtos com suspeita de contaminação, violação ou vencimento;
  • Realizar a entrega dos produtos saneantes nos setores hospitalares, com controle de protocolo de entrega e assinatura dos responsáveis;
  • Dispensar os produtos mediante solicitação via sistema, seguindo o fluxo interno de registro e conferência;
  • Recolher, separar e higienizar os materiais utilizados na manipulação;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Utilizar corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) durante todas as atividades;
  • Acionar os dispositivos de segurança (lava-olhos e chuveiro de emergência) em caso de acidente com produtos químicos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.

Additional information

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

title: SA Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
Lead the Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) for South America, ensuring standardized, efficient and compliant processes across Direct and Indirect Purchasing, Business Office and Purchasing Systems. The role governs policies, processes and systems, secures audit and regulatory compliance, and provides performance visibility to management. A critical mandate is to lead, for South America, the business side of the I‑ERP program, driving the successful implementation and adoption of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing, enabling data‑driven decisions and sustainable operational excellence.

Qualifications

Profile / Requirements

Education

  • University degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems or related field.
  • Post‑graduate degree or MBA is a plus.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in Supply Chain and/or Purchasing, preferably in a multinational and multi‑plant environment.
  • Proven track record in process governance, standardization and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross‑functional projects; prior ERP implementation experience (ideally SAP S/4HANA and/or Ariba) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with audits, compliance programs and policy/procedure management.

Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Purchasing and Supply Chain processes (Direct and Indirect).
  • Good understanding of ERP systems; hands‑on familiarity with SAP and e‑Procurement solutions (e.g., Ariba) is highly valued.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban or SAFe) in project delivery, including backlog management, sprint or increment planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Competence in process mapping and documentation tools; experience with KPI design and performance dashboards (e.g., Excel, Power BI or similar).
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

Languages

  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Fluency in English required for regional and global interaction.

Competencies and Behaviors

Aligned with Ford Behaviors – Focus, Excellence and Collaboration :

  • Focus
    • Sets clear priorities and focuses the organization on the highest‑value Supply Chain and I‑ERP outcomes for South America.
    • Translates strategy into an executable roadmap, ensuring resources and attention are directed to what matters most for customers and the business.
  • Excellence
    • Drives disciplined execution, process rigor and high standards in policies, audits, data quality and systems usage.
    • Uses data and structured problem‑solving to deliver continuous improvement in cost, quality, timing and compliance.
    • Champions best practices and lessons learned from audits and projects, embedding them into standard work.
  • Collaboration
    • Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across countries, plants and functions (Supply Chain, Purchasing, Finance, IT, global CoEs).
    • Facilitates cross‑functional alignment, resolves conflicts constructively and creates a “one team” mindset for I‑ERP and operational initiatives.
    • Communicates clearly and transparently, ensuring stakeholders are informed, engaged and heard.

Additional Behavioral Capabilities

  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through transformation, particularly digital and ERP changes, with strong emphasis on communication, training and user adoption.
  • Results Orientation: Delivers on commitments, manages priorities and deadlines, and ensures projects achieve expected outcomes in terms of cost, quality and timing.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Focus: Balances global standards with local needs; actively listens to internal customers and provides pragmatic, value‑adding solutions.
  • Integrity and Compliance Mindset: Acts as a role model for ethical behavior, policy adherence and audit readiness.

Key Interfaces

  • Regional Purchasing, Supply Chain and Logistics teams
  • Plant and Country management in South America
  • Finance, Controlling and Compliance functions
  • Global Supply Chain and Purchasing Centers of Excellence
  • Global I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) program team and IT organization

title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – AI & Engineering Strategy
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a visionary Deputy CTO with deep experience transforming engineering processes through the strategic use of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The ideal candidate is a hands‑on leader who has successfully guided development teams toward higher velocity, quality, and operational excellence by introducing and optimizing AI‑powered practices.

In this role, you will help us refine, elevate, and scale our existing engineering processes, strengthening the connection between architectural governance, team growth, and customer‑facing technical leadership.

AI-Driven Development Transformation

  • Accelerate SDLC: Lead the adoption of Generative AI tools and coding assistants to reduce cycle times and eliminate repetitive engineering tasks drastically.
  • Measure Impact: Define and track KPIs related to AI adoption (e.g., velocity increase, code quality metrics, reduction in technical debt) to prove ROI.
  • AI Governance & Ethics: Establish a secure framework for using AI tools within the company, ensuring strict adherence to data privacy, IP protection, and security compliance standards.

Technical Architecture & Innovation

  • Architectural Oversight: Design and oversee the roadmap for complex, scalable platforms, ensuring they are built for resilience and future growth.
  • Tech Stack Modernization: Continuously evaluate and optimize our infrastructure and cloud strategy to support high-performance AI integration.
  • Mentorship: Provide high-level technical guidance to Principal Engineers and Architects, resolving complex blockers and fostering technical excellence.

Organizational Leadership & Scaling

  • Team Building: Build and structure high‑performing engineering teams from the ground up, optimizing for agility and cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Process Optimization: Implement "AI-native" workflows that redefine how we hire, onboard, and manage engineering talent for maximum output.
  • Culture of Innovation: Foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, but accountability and delivery are paramount.

Commercial & Client Strategy

  • Serve as the primary technical voice in high‑stakes client meetings, simplifying complex architectural concepts into compelling business value propositions.
  • Business Growth: Partner with Sales and Product teams to articulate the competitive advantage of our AI‑enabled development processes to prospective clients and investors.
  • Client Solution Viability & Compliance: Ensure the flexibility and compliance of AI adoption strategies (governance, tools, data privacy) to meet the diverse security and regulatory requirements of our clients.

Must Have

  • Senior Leadership Experience: 5+ years in a senior technology role (VP of Engineering, CTO, or Deputy CTO) with a focus on software delivery.
  • AI Implementation Track Record: Demonstrable experience leading the transformation of engineering teams through Generative AI (e.g., LLMs for code generation, automated testing suites, and documentation).
  • Proven ROI Analysis: Expertise in quantifying the efficiency gains derived from technical initiatives and reporting these to executive stakeholders.
  • Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of security risks and governance associated with using third‑party AI tools in an enterprise environment.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy for non‑technical audiences.
  • Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Hands‑on experience working with several modern technologies such as .NET, Python, React/React Native, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript , among others. This includes the ability to guide teams across diverse frameworks, evaluate technological trade‑offs, and define best practices across frontend, backend, and full‑stack development.
  • Infrastructure Background: Deep experience in large‑scale system architecture and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Language Skills: Full fluency in English (required). Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is considered a strong plus.

What We Offer

- Strategic Impact: Redefine how software is built.

- Innovation Hub: A collaborative environment where your vision directly shapes our competitive edge in the market.

- Comprehensive Package: Competitive salary, stock options, and premium benefits.

title: Supply Chain Specialist, AWS Infrastructure Services
description:
Supply Chain Specialist, AWS Infrastructure Services

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Supply Chain Specialist, you will be responsible for the creation and processing of Purchase Requisitions aligned to pre-defined SLAs, support IPS‑Procurement implementing sourcing strategies and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will manage metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through the management of competitive bidding processes and analyze data and market trends in support of the category managers. You will also support the continuous improvement of global Procurement processes and tools. The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. Operating in a fast‑moving and sometimes ambiguous environment you will be required to work autonomously taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. Tools and resources change frequently so adaptability is critical. You will continuously look for better ways to manage your work. You should be flexible and adaptable to get into different operational roles within Infrastructure operations. To be successful in this role you have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines, the ability to prioritize workload, exhibit an intense curiosity and learning drive, succeed in a fast‑paced environment, engage and influence key stakeholders, and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of working multiple projects and supporting their completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

Key job responsibilities

  • Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations
  • Plan and execute effective negotiation strategies with vendors
  • Analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies
  • Engage internal stakeholders to ensure minimum requirements to create a PR are met
  • Manage the new supplier qualification and onboarding process
  • Manage RFx events and documentation
  • Support suppliers with issue resolution across the P2P process

Job description

Somos um grupo multimarcas que atua na comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, acessórios, consórcios, frota, seguros e pós-vendas realizado na nossa rede de concessionárias além do serviço de locação (mobilidade).

Buscamos um(a) Vendedor(a) de Peças para promover a venda de peças aos clientes da marca representada, através de um ótimo atendimento pessoal ou contatos telefônicos ativos ou receptivos e outros meios, assegurando o máximo aproveitamento de vendas, garantindo atingimento de metas.

Se você é uma pessoa ágil, que encanta o cliente e preza pela excelência em resultados, venha fazer parte do nossotime !

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar venda de peças ao cliente final ou empresas revendedoras de peças, através de atendimento pessoal no balcão, in loco ou por meios de comunicações ativos e receptivos, a fim de assegurar o máximo aproveitamento nas vendas e o atingimento das metas traçadas pela gestão do departamento;

  • Realizar o atendimento ao cliente varejo, atacado e proprietários de oficina tanto no balcão quanto por telefone ou redes sociais, através de uma abordagem consultiva e assertiva buscando dirimir dúvidas sobre a aplicação correta das peças visando a fidelização do cliente e a maximização das vendas;
  • Realizar os cursos presenciais e via WEB da montadora, através do cronograma de cursos enviado pela Diretoria de Recursos Humanos, a fim de garantir a aprovação e manutenção do índice definido pela montadora;
  • Manter a sua Gerência Superior e Supervisão, informada sobre o andamento dos trabalhos, sob sua responsabilidade, buscando soluções para os problemas encontrados, visando o acompanhamento das atividades pela gestão;
  • Executar outras tarefas que venham a ser delegadas pelo gestor da área;
  • Respeitar as necessidades, a integridade, as expectativas e a privacidade de nossos clientes, colegas, terceiros, fornecedores, comunidades, instituições, além de governos, visando garantir o cumprimento do Código de Ética do Grupo.

Se você:

  • Possui habilidade em negociação;
  • Possui noções de informática;
  • Possui conhecimento de catálogo eletrônico de peças.

O #GrupoNewChase é o seu lugar!

description:
Sr. Process Manager, Outbound - Fulfillment Center ACES, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Specialist for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Specialist, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.

Key job responsibilities

  • being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
  • leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
  • leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
  • owning and managing change on a granular level;
  • performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
  • work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.

A day in the life

You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:

  • FC Ops
  • Middle Mile and Last Mile teams
  • Learning
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Loss Prevention

You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.

About the team

The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience with program or project management.
  • Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams.
  • Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics.
  • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL.
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
  • Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus).
  • Advanced English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience.
  • Experience driving complex process improvements.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization.
  • Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
  • Black Belt certification.

title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist
description:
Job Title: Postdoctoral Project Research Scientist – McTernan lab

Reporting to: Charlie McTernan, Group Leader

Contract: full‑time, fixed term (15 months) on Crick terms and conditions of employment.

Closing date: 3rd December at 23:59.

About us

The Francis Crick Institute is Europe’s largest biomedical research institute under one roof. Our world‑class scientists and staff collaborate on vital research to help prevent, diagnose and treat illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, infectious diseases and neurodegenerative conditions.

About the role

The McTernan Group are a synthetic chemistry group working in supramolecular and biological chemistry, and nanotechnology. We look at how we can apply Supramolecular Chemistry in Biological settings.

Details of research projects currently being undertaken can be seen at: mcternanresearchgroup.com

The Project

This project is a translational and basic research project, looking to apply supramolecular chemistry to create mechanically interlocked peptides, with targeted applications in supramolecular drug delivery systems.

What you will be doing

  • Investigating research questions and developing specific research project(s) under guidance from Group Leader.
  • Providing specialist advice and guidance, sharing knowledge and expertise for the benefit of others.
  • Providing a significant contribution to the production of research papers for publication, presenting findings to group members and other internal and external audiences.
  • Develop ideas for generating research income, and present detailed research proposals.
  • Act as a source of information and advice to other members of the group on scientific protocols and experimental techniques.
  • Have a pro‑active approach to the management of health and safety protocols and play a leading role within the group in ensuring compliance with safety policy.
  • Acting as a leader within the group, helping to maintain a collaborative, kind, and supportive research environment; helping group members to achieve their potential.

About you

  • PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry and/or Chemical Biology and/or Supramolecular Chemistry and/or Solid‑Phase Peptide Synthesis or related field.
  • Expertise in organic synthesis at a high level.
  • Track record of writing papers as evidenced by impactful publications in refereed journals or submitted manuscripts.
  • Evidence of data presentation at scientific meetings.
  • Evidence of ability to supervise and educate junior co‑workers and take part in joint projects.
  • Be willing to lead the organisation and management of the laboratory, assuming a share of group responsibilities, showing excellent organisational and leadership skills.
  • A pro‑active approach to management of laboratory safety.

*Minimum requirements

About Working at the Crick

At the Francis Crick Institute, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving innovation and scientific discovery. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed, regardless of their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ethnicities, abilities, and experiences. We are a Disability Confident: committed employer and want to ensure that everyone can apply and be part of our recruitment processes and so we’ll make reasonable adjustments if you need them – just let us know when you apply. title: ESTÁGIO SUPERIOR EM CONTROLADORIA
description:
Descrição da vaga

O estágio na área da Controladoria está à sua espera! Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e apaixonada, pronta para transformar a mobilidade global, seu lugar é aqui. Na Conti, você terá a oportunidade de encarar desafios, trabalhar em equipe, se desenvolver e ver suas ideias se tornarem realidade.

Diversidade e inclusão são pilares fundamentais do nosso sucesso. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes perfis tornam nosso time ainda mais forte. Por isso, incentivamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), membros da comunidade LGBTI+ e pessoas negras. Sua inscrição será muito bem-vinda! #ContiComigo

Aqui na Conti, essas são as principais atividades dos estagiários área da Controladoria:

  • Participar dos processos de forecast e actual no fechamento mensal para as áreas de logística, manutenção, projetos, produção, entre outras.

  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios e apresentações financeiras utilizados nas reuniões de performance, consolidando resultados e indicadores para a gestão.

  • Apoiar análises de tendência de custos, atualizando informações nos sistemas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.

  • Manter e aprimorar dashboards financeiros e operacionais no Power BI e Excel, integrando dados dos sistemas utilizados na Continental.

  • Contribuir para a otimização de relatórios, automação de planilhas e integração de dados financeiros, buscando eficiência nas rotinas da área.

  • Realizar follow-up com líderes de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e responsáveis por centros de custo sobre o planejamento dos gastos.

  • Apoiar a criação, atualização e controle de elementos PEPs, bem como relatórios financeiros de projetos CAPEX/OPEX e análises de variação.

  • Realizar análises e conciliações entre diferentes sistemas e relatórios, garantindo consistência dos dados.

  • Apoiar o acompanhamento e a reconciliação de dados de scrap entre sistemas.

  • Apoiar a análise e conciliação de inventário e materiais em processo, garantindo a integridade das informações.

Informações adicionais

O QUE OFERECEMOS:

  • Wellhub para diferentes modalidades esportivas;
  • Transporte Fretado;
  • Desconto na compra de pneus;
  • Sala de aleitamento materno;
  • Programa de Apoio Conti;
  • Estacionamento no local;
  • Massoterapia no local;
  • Fisioterapia no local;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Cesta de Natal;
  • Bolsa Auxílio;
  • Kit escolar.
    • \

Pronto para dirigir com a Continental? Dê o primeiro passo e preencha o formulário online.

Qualificações

O QUE PRECISA TER

  • Cursando nível superior em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar por até 2 anos;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Power BI em Nível Intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente na fábrica de Camaçari – BA, de segunda a sexta das 07h às 14h.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER

  • Inglês em nível Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.

Descrição da empresa

A Continental desenvolve tecnologias e serviços pioneiros para a mobilidade sustentável e conectada de pessoas e seus bens. Fundada em 1871, a empresa de tecnologia oferece soluções seguras, eficientes, inteligentes e acessíveis para veículos, máquinas, tráfego e transporte. Em 2021, a Continental gerou vendas de € 33,8 bilhões e emprega atualmente mais de 190 mil pessoas em 58 países e mercados. Em 8 de outubro de 2021, celebrou-se o aniversário de 150 anos da empresa.

Com seu portfólio premium da divisão de carros, caminhões, ônibus, veículos de duas rodas e pneus especiais, o setor Tires do grupo proporciona soluções inovadoras na área da tecnologia de pneus. Os produtos e serviços inteligentes relacionados a pneus e a promoção da sustentabilidade completam o portfólio de produtos. Para os revendedores especializados e gerentes de frotas, o setor Tires oferece sistemas digitais de monitoramento e gerenciamento de pneus, além de outros serviços, com o objetivo de garantir o funcionamento das frotas e aumentar sua eficiência. Com os pneus fornecidos, a Continental faz uma contribuição significativa para a mobilidade segura, eficiente e ecológica.

title: Analista júnior de relações internacionais - international relations analyst (salvador - ba)
description:
AMORIM Global is a  consultancy specialized in International Solutions, providing for individuals and businesses who believe in a world without borders. We offer services related to  international law, immigration, international tax, investor advisory and international business .

ABOUT THE POSITION

As an International Relations Analyst, you will have the opportunity to play a vital role in enhancing our organization s international engagements and relationships. We are seeking a passionate and culturally aware intern to support our international relations efforts in a global context. 

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

As a International Relations Analyst, your daily tasks will include:

  • Research and Analysis: Conduct research on global trends, political, economic, and cultural aspects of target countries and analyze this data to support international strategies.
  • Global Engagement: Support in developing strategies for global market expansion and participate in cross-cultural initiatives to foster international cooperation.
  • Communication and Network: Facilitate international communication and correspondence while also assisting in cultivating international partnerships and connections.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate for this position has:

  • Degree related to International Relations, Diplomacy, or a related field.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong passion for international relations and diplomacy.

Experiência em Desenvolvimento de IA
